W_XP_RANGE: quest XP counts only unfiltered TURNINs (about 82% of budget). Class chains are excluded by design: a Warrior adds 2675 XP (about 94%), a Warlock 1470 (about 89%), a Mage 925, a Rogue 210. Kill XP is not modelled. Non-class characters rely on kills and need the band to be extended in phase 05 if the gap matters.
